bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; limiting city rental housing licensing authority; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 471.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[471.587] RENTAL HOUSING; LIMITATIONS.

Subdivision 1.

Definition.

For purposes of this section, "city" means a statutory or home rule charter city.

Subd. 2.

Maximum annual rental housing license fee.

A city may not charge more than $100 annually for a rental housing license.

Subd. 3.

Lease conditions prohibited.

A city may not require a lease or other contract for rental housing to include specific conditions or requirements that go beyond the requirements for rental housing under state or federal law.

Subd. 4.

Rental housing education.

A city may offer educational programming for owners of rental housing. The programming must be optional and must be available online.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
